description: This file defines an abstract class 'ComputedRawPage' which implements the 'Page' interface. It serves as a base class for pages that are constructed from 'ComputedRaw' content, providing methods to retrieve filename and content.

classes.name: ComputedRawPage
classes.description: An abstract class implementing the 'Page' interface, representing pages built from raw computed content.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a 'ComputedRaw' content instance.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the URI of the raw content, representing the filename.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the full content of the raw content.

methods.name: getPureContent
methods.description: Returns the pure content of the raw content, identical to getContent in this implementation.
